content.short: Media Network is a decentralized, censorship-resistant service and bandwidth marketplace.
content.description: Media Network is a content delivery network that creates a marketplace for decentralized, peer-to-peer bandwidth. Users can hire bandwidth on demand from a network of decentralized providers, enabling flexible, on-demand delivery of content. Developers can earn $MEDIA rewards by contributing their bandwidth to the network. The protocol lets participants serve content without relying on trusted intermediaries or pre-authentication, reducing centralized trust and enabling direct participation in bandwidth sharing.
